L=np.log(eps); M=np.log(T); y=np.log(sigma)
def fit(cols,names):
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)
    r=y-A@c
    print(names, np.round(c,3), "rms", np.sqrt(np.mean(r**2)))
    return r
